entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane of varied terrain and countless historic locations, birthplace of Urza and Mishra and epicenter of the temporal-planar fractures.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A master artificer born on Dominaria, brother of Mishra, who discovered the plane of Phyrexia at the end of their war.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: A master artificer born on Dominaria, brother of Urza.

entities.name: The Caves of Koilos
entities.description: The place where Urza and Mishra discovered ancient stones of power.

entities.name: The Brothers' War
entities.description: The savage war between Urza and Mishra that devastated Dominaria and plunged it into an ice age.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: A dark plane, a hell of flesh, metal and grease where the line between living and artificial is blurred.

entities.name: The Weatherlight
entities.description: A skyship with ancient magical technology that lets it planeswalk; with its crew it thwarted the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: The Legacy
entities.description: A collection of artifacts, including the planeswalker Karn, instrumental in thwarting the invasion.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A planeswalker included in the collection of artifacts called the Legacy.

entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: A cult growing in strength, now under the control of the Demonlord Belzenlok.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: The demonlord who now controls the cult of the Cabal.

events.summary: Urza and Mishra wage a savage war on each other, devastating Dominaria and plunging it into an ice age.
events.quote: the brothers waged a savage war against each other, devastating Dominaria and plunging the plane into an ice age.

events.summary: At the end of the war, Urza discovers the dark plane of Phyrexia.
events.quote: At the end of this war, Urza discovered the dark plane of Phyrexia

events.summary: The Weatherlight and its crew, with the Legacy including Karn, thwart Phyrexia's near invasion of Dominaria.
events.quote: Phyrexia nearly invaded Dominaria, were it not for the skyship Weatherlight and its crew.

events.summary: Cataclysms, many caused by planeswalkers, leave Dominaria desolated and destabilize the Multiverse; powerful planeswalkers intervene to mend the rifts.
events.quote: A handful of powerful Planeswalkers intervened to mend the rifts, thus restabilizing all the planes.

events.summary: After generations of peace, much of Dominaria rebuilds its past cultures.
events.quote: Today, after generations of peaceful development, much of Dominaria has managed to rebuild the cultures of its past.

events.summary: The Cabal grows in strength under the Demonlord Belzenlok, posing new threats to Dominaria.
events.quote: as the cult of the Cabal grows in strength, now under the control of the Demonlord Belzenlok, Dominaria faces new threats
